description: Starts a ChangeNOW swap for a get_credits_quote and returns order_id, pay_in_address (+ extra_id), the exact amount and expires_at. Credits are added automatically once the TFUEL arrives; poll get_credits_status. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify). At most 3 open orders and 10 a day.

accept_terms.description: true on your first order to accept the terms (v2)

refund_address.description: Your own address on the pay-in coin's chain; ChangeNOW refunds go only there
